news.headline: Brazil headed to runoff after Bolsonaro's son leads
news.body: Brazil's presidential election is set for a second-round runoff after Senator Flávio Bolsonaro held a narrow lead in Sunday's first round, projections showed. Polls point to a tight Oct. 25 runoff with incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, and observers warned of a closely fought contest.

footerNote: All times converted from official kickoffs
